name: Doenjang
description: Soybeans fermented in brine for months to years — earthier and saltier than miso.

tcm.note: A long salty ferment; warming and descending.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; garam by ferment and salt.

histamine.note: Years of ferment in some households — higher again than miso.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.
